description:
## [1.4.0](https://github.com/azain47/blackmagic-camera-patches/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0) (2026-10-27)

### ✨ New Features

* 3.5.1 support + user-configurable bitrate split ([92914e7](https://github.com/azain47/blackmagic-camera-patches/commit/92914e7f36fbfec681dbd8ec91d6df9dd823ef1f))

patches.name: Configurable bitrate tiers
patches.description: Rescales the LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH video bitrate tiers to a configurable percentage of the encoder's maximum (MAX is unchanged); defaults are 25 / 50 / 75 %. At 1080p30 H.265 on a flagship this turns the stock 6 / 9 / 12 / 160 Mbps options into usable ~40 / 80 / 120 / 160 Mbps steps, removing the order-of-magnitude gap to MAX.

options.description: LOW bitrate as a percentage of the encoder's maximum (1-100).
MEDIUM bitrate as a percentage of the encoder's maximum (1-100).
HIGH bitrate as a percentage of the encoder's maximum (1-100).

patches.name: Disable license check
patches.description: Disables the PairIP license verification that force-quits a re-signed build. Required for any patched build to launch.

patches.name: Smooth gallery thumbnails
patches.description: Replaces the in-app gallery's grid thumbnail fetcher, which spins up a full ExoPlayer + GL-readback pipeline per cell (hundreds of MB of transient graphics memory and a short-lived player for every tile), with a direct MediaMetadataRetriever.getScaledFrameAtTime decode at the tile size. This removes the memory spikes that make browsing stutter and can trigger the low-memory killer mid-record.

patches.name: Unlock developer options
patches.description: Reveals the hidden internal "Development" settings category (debug UI overlay, software-encoder selection, custom bitrate field, camera-DB reload, etc.), which the stock release build gates behind an "internal builds only" check. Off by default: these are debug toggles, and some do nothing useful on a retail device.
